name: Thumbnail Task Identity & Visibility Telemetry
changes: Queued Image and Video thumbnail tasks now verify their stable sourceArticleKey before execution and relocate to the live article index when continuous browsing has rebuilt or shifted the article array.
Thumbnail tasks whose source article disappeared or no longer contains compatible complete media are discarded locally instead of sending mismatched media/segment data to the thumbnail endpoint.

Browsing telemetry schema 10 preserves total thumbnail queue age while separately measuring offscreen/prefetch dwell and actual visible wait, and records stable-identity relocations/discards for passive acceptance evidence.

The thumbnail scheduler scoring formula, Image HTTP admission limit 5, high-connection Video ceiling 6, 24 MB/12-segment Video sample bounds, 800/800/1000 header strategy, All Posts resolver waits, Settings reliability, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Smart Import, Automation, Discover and Metadata Server behavior are unchanged.
regression_guards: Every queued gallery and Related Media thumbnail task is resolved against sourceArticleKey before Image/Video fetch execution; stale missing or incompatible work is discarded without a thumbnail HTTP request.

Stable-key relocation updates the live task index used for DOM/error completion without changing scheduler scoring, queue limits, cancellation/session/generation checks, cache keys, retry policy, or provider allocation.

thumbnail_queue remains total queue age; schema-10 thumbnail_prefetch_dwell and thumbnail_visible_wait partition offscreen dwell from time actually visible before execution, and thumbnail_task_identity reports only passive local decisions.

Image admission stays 5, high-connection Video ceiling stays 6, Video sample bounds stay 24 MB/12 segments, headers stay 800/800/1000, All Posts wait bounds stay unchanged, settings replacement retries remain Windows 5/32/33 for 3 seconds, SAB stays 5.1.2, and terminal-history schema stays 3.
